text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Ooh...!
choice_data_list: That plating is already perfect!
That plating looks perfect, doesn't it!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Plus, the soup, chashu pork, seasoned 
egg, bamboo shoots... the flavor of 
everything is spot on!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
...Still, it feels like it's still missing 
something. To truly be called "the 
ultimate ramen," that is.
choice_data_list:
For now, it's just a delicious bowl of 
ramen, you know...

For now, it's just a delicious bowl of 
ramen, okay...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
...Let's see if we can add one more twist 
to it. Aiming for our very own "ultimate 
ramen"!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
So, here's Strategy Number 1! 'Get picky 
about the bowl'!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Color balance, texture, special gimmicks. 
I've prepared 10 varieties crafted with 
great care! ...Let's find the absolute 
best one!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
The white makes the broth pop... and the 
black makes the toppings pop... A message 
that appears and disappears with the 
temperature...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Huh... They're all good? Every single one 
is great? What should I do... I can't 
choose!
choice_data_list: M-Maybe simple really is best...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
"Strategy number two: Don't just get 
ramen, make it a 'Ramen Combo'!"

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
What I've prepared today is classic fried 
rice! The grains are nice and separate, 
and it's packed with chunky roast pork!
choice_data_list: I could eat endless bowls of this!

I feel like I could eat endless bowls of 
this!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Yes! With this fried rice, I'm sure Sensei 
will—

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
...Huh? But I don't think they're gonna be 
happy just because it's ramen...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
We walked around town after that and 
investigated various things, but...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
None of these feel quite right... 
Besides...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Grumble gurgle...)

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Waaah! I-I'm so sorry! At a time like 
this...
choice_data_list:
Yeah, me too... Let's get something to eat 
first.

No, me too... How about we get something 
to eat first?

text_block_list.name: Ramen Shop Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Coming right up! Two bowls of ramen, order 
up!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Aaah... I feel reborn...
choice_data_list: That really seeps right into my soul...
That really hits the spot...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Yes... And this taste brings back 
memories. Of when my teacher scolded me 
right here two years ago.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
When we heard the teacher was coming to 
watch our training, we got a little too 
fired up.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
So I ended up stiffening up weirdly... and 
the teacher was exasperated, saying I was 
'worrying about unnecessary things'...
choice_data_list:
How nostalgic... Has it already been two 
years?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
"...I still hesitate a lot, but compared 
to back then, I've grown at least a little 
bit, right?"

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
At least right now, we're able to take a 
step back and cool down on our own!
choice_data_list:
Yeah. We got scolded, but it's a fond 
memory.

Right. We got scolded, but it's a fond 
memory.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Yes! That... is true, isn't it...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
choice_data_list: Top Road?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: "...Trainer. It might be 'memories'."

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
The final piece needed for the "ultimate 
ramen" that only we can serve.
choice_data_list: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
I'll top the ramen... with my 'memories' 
with Sensei.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
"Because 'memories' are something special 
that exist only between us and Sensei."

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
"And if they could feel our growth through 
the ramen..."
choice_data_list:
That becomes a truly one-of-a-kind 
"flavor"...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Then it suddenly hits you. ...If so, there 
is one more ingredient that simply cannot 
be left out.
choice_data_list:
...Winning is what makes it meaningful, 
after all.

...Winning is what makes it meaningful, 
after all.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"‘Memories’ alone lack punch. If we want 
them to feel the growth..."

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: —Only by winning the race.
choice_data_list: Yeah.
Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
...The path has become clear, hasn't it? 
In that case...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Let us run together, the two of us! Along 
the path to victory—leading to the 
'ultimate ramen'!
